plugin.name: Rascal Terminal Commands
plugin.description: Implements the rascalmpl.importModule / rascalmpl.runMain LSP commands -- the CodeLenses Rascal's LSP server emits above module and main() declarations -- for LSP4IJ, matching what the official VS Code extension does. Also auto-discovers the Rascal debug port on run and attaches LSP4IJ's DAP configuration automatically, no manual port lookup or config editing needed. Also bridges Rascal's std:/// location scheme to IntelliJ's VFS, so "Go to Definition" into standard library symbols (IO, List, Set, String, util::FileSystem, etc.) works instead of silently failing.
plugin.change-notes:
